photos.name: img-7630
photos.summary: Two shaped loaves resting on the silicone mat under inverted glass bowls, bench scraper between them. Bulk-fermented dough at the preshape/shape stage on the kitchen counter.

photos.name: img-7632
photos.summary: Loaf 1 fresh out of the oven on a copper wire rack, cross score blown wide open with strong oven spring. Dark caramelized crust dusted with flour, stovetop and oven panel in the background.

photos.name: img-7633
photos.summary: Side profile of loaf 1 held up next to a wooden-handled bread knife to show height — tall, well-domed crumb-side, with one deep slash flared open and a defined ear along the score.

photos.name: img-7635
photos.summary: Two slices of crumb in direct sunlight, ruler resting on top showing roughly 4 inches across. Open and evenly distributed crumb with a few larger holes, creamy interior, thin crust.

photos.name: img-7636
photos.summary: Loaf 2 cooling on the wire rack, single curved side score blown open into a clean ear. Floury, dark amber crust with light blistering, bench scraper held behind for backdrop.

photos.name: img-7638
photos.summary: Three-quarter view of loaf 2 on the wire rack with a deeper bake — single side score gaping into a thick ear, crust mottled mahogany and floured white across the top.
